title: hieracium juranum subsp. lividulum
intro: Hieracium juranum subsp. lividulum, commonly known as a plant species within the dandelion family, is a type of flowering plant known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Hieracium juranum subsp. lividulum include its potential to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which may help protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that may exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective effects. However, further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
